neutrophils are involved in acute myocardial injury, adverse cardiac remodellings and neointima development after angioplasty and that pharmacological means that target neutrophils are effective in preclinical model of acute myocardial injury.
neutrophil-mediated inflammation is a major contributor to the pathophysiology of acute myocardial ischaemia and reperfusion injury.
